$comment: Used by scripts/typecheck.sh (npm run check). Committed on purpose: the
paths block is what makes this a real gate. node_modules in these repos is
a hand-built symlink tree pointing at the global pi install, and
@earendil-works/pi-ai there is a 0.0.0-test stub with no declarations — so
a plain tsc run resolved the host API to `any` and checked almost nothing.
The pinned peer packages are installed into gitignored .tools/ and mapped
explicitly, so the typecheck runs against the same host API version the
extension declares, regardless of what the local tree happens to contain.
